keyword.en: how to read concrete pump m3/h on a catalogue
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵立方米每小时在目录里怎么写

title.en: Reading Theoretical Output Is Written on a Pinjin Sheet with a picture from Rebar
title.zh: 读品锦参数页怎样书写理论输送量，配图来自「鋼筋」

description.en: Theoretical Output Is Written on a Pinjin Sheet. 8–10 m³/h stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Rebar.
description.zh: 品锦参数页怎样书写理论输送量。8–10 m³/h仍在目录格子里。插图来自「鋼筋」。

h1.en: Reading Theoretical Output Is Written on a Pinjin Sheet with a picture from Rebar
h1.zh: 读品锦参数页怎样书写理论输送量，配图来自「鋼筋」

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery writes theoretical output in more than one way on its Xingtai concrete pumps. Electric 20 lists a range, 8–10 m³/h. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵上用不止一种写法标出理论输送量。LZ-80 是两档上限：高压 ≤ 65 m³/h，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar. Subject: A bunch of rebar. Hebei Pinjin Machinery writes theoretical output in more than one way on its Xingtai concrete pumps. LZ-80 lists two ceilings, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Only LZ-80 uses the paired ≤ ceilings. The 66–75 spread is on the engine line. Diesel 30 lists 15 m³/h, not 30.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar。画面主体：A bunch of rebar。河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵上用不止一种写法标出理论输送量。单值包括电动60的 40 m³/h 和 HBT8018 的 60 m³/h。

heading.zh: 在混凝土和砌体中的用途

body.en: Electric 20 lists a range, 8–10 m³/h. A range is not a promise of the top number, and the ≤ sign is part of the LZ-80 entry. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists these in Xingtai. The output line is a single 25 m³/h. Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h, not 80.
body.zh: LZ-80 是两档上限：高压 ≤ 65 m³/h，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。柴油搅拌泵的发动机为 4108 / 66–75 kW，理论输送量为 25 m³/h。

body.en: Electric 40 lists a single figure, 21 m³/h. Range examples on concrete pumps include Electric 15 at 8–10 m³/h, Electric 30 at 12–15 m³/h, the Tractor-Driven 4100 at 6–12 m³/h and the rural diesel pump at 5–8 m³/h. Do not turn a range into a single guaranteed site total. Read the row title before you treat a hyphen as output. Hebei Pinjin Machinery's concrete pump names are commercial labels.
body.zh: 范围不是顶格承诺，≤ 符号是 LZ-80 格子的一部分。请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ 的产量格，而不是只读铭牌。

body.en: Diesel 120 lists 100 m³/h. Single figures include Electric 60 at 40 m³/h and HBT8018 at 60 m³/h. The diesel mixer lists engine 4108 / 66–75 kW and theoretical output 25 m³/h. Electric 10 lists 21 m³/h, not 10. Open the output entry on /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ rather than reading the badge.
body.zh: 混凝土泵上的范围例子包括电动15的 8–10 m³/h、电动30的 12–15 m³/h、拖拉机带动4100的 6–12 m³/h 和农村柴油泵的 5–8 m³/h。

question.en: On this row: What does 8–10 m³/h mean?

answer.en: It is the theoretical-output range shown on that concrete pump page, for example Electric 20 and Electric 15. It is not a single guaranteed site total. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar.
answer.zh: 它是该混凝土泵页面写出的理论输送量范围，例如电动20和电动15。它不是单一的工地保证值。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Which pump uses a less-than-or-equal output?
question.zh: 哪台泵的产量带小于等于号？

answer.en: LZ-80 lists high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h and low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Other concrete pumps in this catalogue do not use that paired ceiling. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar.
answer.zh: LZ-80 标出高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、低压 ≤ 95 m³/h。本目录其他混凝土泵没有使用这一对上限。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is 66–75 kW an output range?

answer.en: No. On the diesel mixer that spread is the engine line. Output on that page is 25 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar.
answer.zh: 不是。在柴油搅拌泵上，这个区间是发动机行。该页产量是 25 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Does Electric 80 deliver 80 m³/h?
question.zh: 电动80的产量是 80 m³/h 吗？

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists 60 m³/h on the Electric 80 page in Xingtai. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar.
answer.zh: 不是。河北品锦机械在邢台的电动80页面标出的是 60 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rebar画面里印出的数字。
